output.summary: The evidence points to a reliability debt loop. The reliability roadmap was paused for Meridian, and overdue postmortem action items piled up. 60% of Q3 SEV1-SEV2 incidents repeated a failure mode with a filed, overdue fix. Interrupt work now takes 48% of hours, and 44 of 52 deferrals cite incident load. Storage cleared its backlog and its incidents fell while traffic share stayed flat, which acts as a natural experiment. The Networking pilot of a second primary slot did not help: acknowledgement time was flat and incidents rose. Volume grew only 7%, and the tool migration did not touch SEV1-SEV2 counts. Attrition looks driven by both on-call burden and pay. A2 is preferred. A1 and A5 are harmful. A4 is premature, and an A3 exception request is acceptable.
